cancel: Button in a room dialog that closes it and keeps everything as it was.
day: A short date (month and day) inside other room dialog strings; `at` is the date.
clock: A time of day inside other room dialog strings; `at` is the time.
create.title: Heading of the dialog that makes a new room. "Room" is a product noun: one conversation several people and AI socios share.
create.description: Explains what a room is. "socio" is the product's word for an AI agent; company socios are ones the workspace shares.
create.action: Main button of the Create room dialog.
create.busy: The create button's label while the room is being made.
create.created: Toast after a room is made; `title` is its name. "Members" is the name of the room's people panel.
create.failed: Error in the Create room dialog when the room couldn't be made (shown when the server gives no reason). "Room" is a product noun.
create.name: Label of the room name field in the Create room dialog.
create.name-placeholder: Example room name in the empty name field.
create.lead: Field label: the AI socio that answers in the room by default.
create.lead-hint: Hint under the lead socio picker; the _none form shows when no company socio exists yet.
create.more: Label of the picker of further socios (AI agents) for the room, besides the lead.
create.more-hint: Hint under the list of further socios: each one needs a workspace admin's approval.
create.people: Label of the picker of workspace people to invite to the new room.
create.people-hint: Hint under the people picker in the Create room dialog: the creator is already a member and room admin; each person picked gets an invitation they must accept.
create.purpose: Label of the room's optional description field.
create.purpose-hint: Hint under the room's optional description field in the Create room dialog: the description is shown to the room's members.
create.purpose-placeholder: Placeholder in the room's optional description field.
convert.title: Heading of the dialog that turns a private chat into a room.
convert.action: Main button of the dialog that turns a private chat into a room.
convert.busy: The button's label while the chat is being made a room.
convert.done: Toast once the chat is a room. "Members" is the room's people panel.
convert.failed: Error in the dialog that turns a private chat into a room, when that failed (shown when the server gives no reason).
convert.confirm: Checkbox the person must tick before the chat becomes a room.
rename.title: Heading of the dialog that renames a room.
rename.description: Line under the heading of the Rename room dialog: every member of the room sees the new name.
rename.action: Button in the Rename room dialog: saves the new name.
rename.busy: The save button's label while the new name saves.
rename.failed: Error in the Rename room dialog when the new name couldn't be saved (shown when the server gives no reason).
rename.name: Label of the name field in the Rename room dialog.
leave.title: Heading of the dialog to leave a room; `title` is the room's name.
leave.description: What leaving does. _stuck: the person is the room's only member, so they archive it instead. _handover: they are its last admin and must pick a new admin first.
leave.action: The dialog's main button. _stuck: archives the room instead. _handover: gives the admin role to someone, then leaves.
leave.busy: The main button's label while leaving.
leave.failed: Error in the Leave room dialog when leaving (or archiving or handing over, in its other forms) failed; shown when the server gives no reason.
leave.new-admin: Label of the picker for who becomes the room's admin.
invites.title: Heading of the dialog that lists the person's invitations to rooms.
invites.description: Line under the heading of the dialog that lists the person's room invitations: joining lets them read and write in the room; nobody sees its messages before joining.
invites.none: In the invitations dialog when no room invitation waits.
invites.list: Accessible name of the list of invitations.
invites.failed: Error on a room invitation in the invitations dialog when joining or declining failed (shown when the server gives no reason).
invites.invited-by: Start of an invitation's line; `name` is who invited them. _admin: they are invited as a room admin.
invites.invited: Start of an invitation's line when who invited them is unknown. _admin: as a room admin.
invites.members: Part of an invitation's line: how many people are in the room.
invites.until: Part of an invitation's line: when it expires. <date></date> is replaced by a short date; keep the tags.
invites.understood: Checkbox the person ticks after reading what joining shares, before Join room works.
invites.decline: Button on a room invitation: turns it down.
invites.decline-label: Accessible name of the Decline button; `title` is the room's name.
invites.declining: The Decline button's label while it works.
invites.join: Button on a room invitation: accepts it and joins the room.
invites.join-label: Accessible name of the Join room button; must start with the same words as invites.join. `title` is the room's name.
invites.joining: The Join room button's label while it works.
topic.name: A Telegram forum topic, as a sentence names it; `id` is its number. _general: Telegram's built-in General topic.
topic.title: Heading of the dialog that links a room to a Telegram forum topic. Telegram is a product name.
topic.description: "the bot" is Socio's Telegram bot; "socio" is the AI agent.
topic.loading: In the Telegram topic dialog while the room's link loads.
topic.linked: `topic` is topic.name's words; <date></date> becomes a short date (keep the tags). _by adds `name`, who linked it.
topic.ended: `topic` is topic.name's words; <date></date> becomes the short date the link ended (keep the tags).
topic.not-linked: In the Telegram topic dialog when the room is linked to no Telegram forum topic.
topic.unavailable: Shown to a room admin in the Telegram topic dialog when this server has no Telegram bot set up, so the room can't be linked to a topic. Telegram is a brand name.
topic.link-account: "Telegram" in the sidebar is the name of a page; the code is a one-time code to post in the topic.
topic.understood: Checkbox the admin ticks before getting a code.
topic.unanswered: Heading of the list of people the socio didn't answer in the topic.
topic.not-in-room: Note beside a person's name: they aren't a member of the room.
topic.no-username: Stands in for a Telegram sender's name when they have no @username.
topic.not-on-socio: A Telegram sender with no Socio account; `sender` is their @username or a description.
topic.seen: Heading of the list of people seen writing in the Telegram group.
topic.seen-hint: Hint under the Telegram topic dialog's list of people seen in the Telegram group: they have a Socio account linked to Telegram, wrote in the group and aren't room members; inviting them still needs their acceptance.
topic.invite: Button beside a person seen writing in the Telegram group: invites them to the room.
topic.invite-failed: Toast when inviting a person from the Telegram topic dialog's lists to the room failed (shown when the server gives no reason).
topic.close: Button that closes the Telegram topic dialog.
topic.unlink: Button for a room admin: ends the link between the room and its Telegram topic.
topic.unlinked: Toast after the room's link to its Telegram topic ended.
topic.unlink-failed: Error in the Telegram topic dialog when unlinking the room from its Telegram topic failed (shown when the server gives no reason).
topic.get-code: Button for a room admin: gets a one-time code to post in the Telegram topic, which links it to the room.
topic.code-failed: Error when the server couldn't give the code (a command to send in Telegram) that links a Telegram topic, in the Telegram topic dialog or the dialog that makes a topic a room.
topic.now-linked: Toast once the code was posted and the topic is linked.
topic.read-failed: Toast when the room's Telegram topic settings couldn't be read; the Telegram topic dialog closes.
steps.send: Before a command the person copies and sends in Telegram.
steps.copy-label: Accessible name of the Copy button beside the command.
steps.copy: Button beside a command to send in Telegram: copies the command.
steps.copied: Toast after the command was copied.
steps.copy-failed: Toast when the Copy button beside the Telegram command (the code to send in the topic) couldn't copy it to the clipboard; the person can select the command's text and copy it themselves.
steps.expires: <time></time> becomes a time of day (keep the tags); `bot` is the bot's Telegram username, after @.
convert-topic.title: Heading of the dialog that makes a legacy Telegram team topic a room.
convert-topic.description: Line under the heading of the dialog that makes a Telegram team conversation a room: the new room has the reader as admin, keeps the topic's socio (AI agent) and stays linked to the Telegram topic.
convert-topic.code-title: The same dialog's heading once the code is shown.
convert-topic.code-description: "Rooms" is the sidebar's list; "Members" is the room's people panel.
convert-topic.busy: The button's label while the code is requested.
convert-topic.action: Main button of the dialog that makes a Telegram team topic a room: gets a one-time code.
convert-topic.done: Button that closes the dialog once the code was shown.
